messages:
Lena Ortiz: quick a11y sweep of the Models page toolbar — saw weird tab order when toolbar is docked to bottom on small screens. Tab goes: first interactive in content -> skiplink -> toolbar controls -> back to content. Feels backward. Diego Morales: is the toolbar injected at the end of DOM or absolutely positioned? That affects tabindex flow. Lena Ortiz: it's absolutely positioned and appended as last child of body via a portal. So DOM order puts it after content which is why tab hits it late. Rina Sato: portal is fine but for keyboard users the expected order should be logical reading order. For a bottom docked toolbar users often want to reach it early (controls to filter/refresh). We could add a skip link that targets the toolbar or move it earlier in DOM when visible. Evan Li: moving in DOM will affect screen readers since VO reads in DOM order; but we can maintain visual layout with CSS while placing toolbar earlier in markup. a11y-bot: automated-check: skip-links missing on page, landmark roles present but footer lacks role="contentinfo", color-contrast for toolbar buttons against bg = 3.2:1 (fails AA normal text). Lena Ortiz: good catch on contentinfo. Also toolbar button labels are icons-only currently with aria-label="Refresh" etc. VoiceOver reads them but NVDA sometimes doesn't announce label if aria-hidden spans inside. Need to audit markup. Diego Morales: can we add visually hidden text inside the button rather than aria-label? That tends to be more robust across AT. But icons should keep aria-hidden=true on the svg. Rina Sato: agree. Prefer . Also add aria-pressed for toggle buttons. Evan Li: regarding tab order, alternative is to include a skip link at top: "Skip to toolbar" that becomes visible on focus and points to toolbar id. That gives users a predictable way to jump. Lena Ortiz: skip link is nice but needs tabindex order — it should be the first focusable element. We have other interactive items in header (search). How do we avoid adding friction? Rina Sato: skip links typically are first in DOM but visually hidden until focused. Header controls remain in logical order. The skip link offers an explicit path for keyboard/AT users. Diego Morales: small nuance: when toolbar receives focus via skip link, ensure focus is set to the first interactive control inside toolbar, not the container. Use tabindex="-1" on the container and programmatically focus first control so screen readers announce context. a11y-bot: note: focus outline token for --focus-ring is 2px currently; WCAG recommends at least 3px thick for low-vision users. Evan Li: we'll bump to 3px and use focus-visible to avoid outlines on mouse. Also ensure outline color contrasts with toolbar bg. Lena Ortiz: also spotted heading structure inside the panel — h3 used for section but omitted aria-level in custom heading component. For AT we just need semantic tags not CSS. Avoid role="heading" without level. Rina Sato: yes replace role-heading hacks with

. If we use a visual-only heading, add role="heading" and aria-level. But prefer semantic elements. Diego Morales: I'll prototype two options: 1) bring toolbar earlier in DOM and visually position it bottom via CSS, 2) add skip-to-toolbar link + tabindex management. We'll test both with VoiceOver and NVDA. Evan Li: please add test matrix: Safari+VO, Chrome+NVDA, Firefox+Jaws if possible. Also include mobile VoiceOver with virtual rotor behavior for docked toolbar. Lena Ortiz: for mobile rotor, ensure toolbar buttons have role="button" and are included in quick nav. If toolbar uses small icons only, add larger touch targets and ensure 44px min touch size. a11y-bot: checklist: add skip link, add role="contentinfo" to footer, change toolbar button markup to include sr-only text, increase focus ring to 3px, bump toolbar button contrast token to --interactive-strong. Rina Sato: tiny copy tweak: for the refresh tooltip use "Refresh models" instead of "Reload" so screen reader users have more context. Diego Morales: noted. I'll add aria-label="Refresh models" as fallback but still include visible sr-only text. Evan Li: leaving an implementation note: when moving toolbar in DOM, update any CSS relying on sibling selectors. Also update tests that query by document order. Lena Ortiz: thanks team. Diego, can you open a draft PR with both approaches and mark one as preferred? We'll run axe/pa11y in storybook before merging. Diego Morales: will do. Targeting draft by EOD. Ping me if you want to join testing sessions. :mag:
